messages.subject: Posting Json Result to Rook
messages.body_plain:
Hi  ,

I am trying to post json result from my web service to Rook. I am able to send json resuls as a url query string .
Example :  http://10.1.32.45:8080/custom/helloworldTestJson?p={%22x%22:[1.5,2,7,8,15],%22y%22:[1.5,2,7,8,15]} <http://10.1.32.45:8080/custom/helloworldTestJson?p=%7B%22x%22:[1.5,2,7,8,15],%22y%22:[1.5,2,7,8,15]%7D>

But I want to pass long json dataset . Is it possibe to post with out using url query string  and reading in R .

Thanks .
